Datatable.LocalizationPair: Constructs must be built in the Construction Queue; they do not "grow" normally.
Constructs can abosrb the genetic material of other lifeforms to enhance their functions and abilities. Absorption requires the sacrifice of some lesser species.
Systems which only have Riftborn/[C][O][N][S][T][R][U][C][T] affinity populations don't have System Growth

[E][L][I][M][I][N][A][T][E] [T][H][E] [P][I][R][A][T][E][S] As the first Constructs settle on new worlds ripe with resources; sensors indicate hostile assets orbiting nearby systems. If these Pirates reveal our presence or subdue a Construct asset, it could be detrimental to the Ascension's planning. Purge these pathetic life-forms from existance so that the Ascension may continue unimpeded.
Destroy the indicated Pirate fleets in or near your home constellation.
All other fleets must be eradicated to ensure the safety of your new home.

[O][B][T][A][I][N] [A][D][D][I][T][I][O][N][A][L] [M][A][T][E][R][I][A][L] [F][O][R] [T][H][E] [A][S][C][E][N][S][I][O][N]. With this filth purged from the galaxy, the territory surrounding the Host is secure, and we can begin seeking new life and resources to expand the Constructs prowess. Local scans indicate high concentrations of genetic and material resources, however only one can be the focus at this time.
Brainwash a new Minor Civilization to learn more about this galaxy.
Use the "Assimilate" Diplomacy Action to convert the Minor Civilization. However, you can invade the Minor Civilization's system, asserting control over them instead.

[O][B][T][A][I][N] [A][D][D][I][T][I][O][N][A][L] [M][A][T][E][R][I][A][L] [F][O][R] [T][H][E] [A][S][C][E][N][S][I][O][N]. Curiosities can be discovered by entering a System; explore Curiosities using probes with the Fleet Action "Start Expedition".

[E][X][P][L][O][R][E] [T][H][E] [L][O][S][T] [L][I][B][R][A][R][Y] Through their blessed sacrifice, the lesser species has given morethan their civilization could ever hope to achieve. Significant data has been extracted from nearby anomalies, boosting production and guiding the Constructs towards a feint signal. We have obtained information regarding the Lost Library of the Eternum. Seek it out and discover it's secrets.
With a level 5 or higher Hero, explore the $TabernacleSystemName System where the Lost Library is located.
A Hero starts leveling up if they are assigned to a Fleet or System.

Additional Genetic Material is is crucial to the advancement of the Construct's functions and abilities.

[E][X][E][R][T] [I][N][F][L][U][E][N][C][E] With the Library found and it's secrets uncovered, the Ascension bounds ahead of statistical planning. Current estimates indicate numerous Life-Forms of high genetic quality that will be exceptional additions to the Constructs prowess.
End the turn with a stock of $MinAmount01Name [prestigeColored] in your Empire.
You can do this by building Planetary and System Improvements or by cancelling Laws that consume [prestigeColored].

[E][X][E][R][T] [I][N][F][L][U][E][N][C][E] With numerous species under the influence of The Watcher, the galaxy approaches the time of the ascension. Exert yourinfluence upon the masses, and usher in a new age of magnificence.
Maintain for $Amount01Name [turn], at least $Amount02Name Laws which are not Religious or neutral.

If the [religiousColored] #D9C282#Religious#REVERT# ideology is elected, it automatically votes in a law. Prevent that from happening and don't pass other Religious laws. Also, remember that you can cancel a law at any time
[B][L][O][W] [I][T] [U][P] With the plan laid bare and a new age approaching, dominance must be established in the galaxy.
Destroy $Amount01Name planets of Type Hot. Endless Ruins and their precious Dust will be destroyed as well.
You will need the "Core Cracker" module to destroy planets.
